messages:
jessie: bringing up kamino-3b from the community model zoo, running a quick onboard + int8 pass. hitting kv-cache desync after ~520 tokens on long chat tests. anyone seen vocab/pad-related alignment issues with new tokenizers?
cheng: can you share the tokenizer.json and the token ids around <pad>/<eos>? sounds like id-shift or normalization mismatch.
jessie: here's a tiny repro snippet and the tail of the log:
```python
# load tokenizer & model, run a long batch
ids = tok.encode('A long multilingual prompt...')
# pad/truncate logic we run:
if len(ids) % 8 != 0:
    ids = ids + [tok.pad_token_id] * (8 - (len(ids) % 8))
outputs = model.generate(ids, max_length=1024)
```
log tail:
```
kv step 512 -> kv_step 513 mismatch: cache_index 0 vs 1
decoded tokens around 512: [1292, 0, 0, 304, 11]
expected around 512: [1292, 11, 21, 304, 11]
```
cheng: hmm that decoded tokens snippet looks like padded zeros leaking into the stream rather than being handled as sentinel PAD. What tokenizer library/version? some tokenizers use pad=0 but others use a different special-id and rely on attention masking.
tara: also check byte-level normalization (NFC vs NFKC). We had a subtle case where normalization changed multi-byte punctuation into extra tokens and shifted kv indices after quant.
jessie: tokenizer.json: pad_token_id = 0, eos_token_id = 2, unk=1. We used tokenizers v0.13.2 on import. Model's config.json lists eos=3 though. possible mismatch between saved vocab and deployed cfg.
mike: that eos mismatch is suspicious. If model weights were exported with a different vocab ordering then quantization (per-tensor int8) can permute per-row scales and amplify aliasing. Try PTQ with per-channel scaling (quantize.aware_perchannel=True) and remap the vocab ids with a small conversion table.
cheng: quick remap you can run locally: map ids from model_vocab -> tokenizer_vocab using the index file (vocab.txt) and patch embedding rows before quant: ```python
embed.weight.data = embed.weight.data[remap_indices]
```
that preserves embedding order before quantizing.
jessie: did a quick test: float32 perplexities on eval set: 12.4; int8 naive: 18.9; int8 per-channel remapped: 13.1. so remap + per-channel helps a lot.
tara: nice. can you also run a short generation smoke with long context to ensure kv-cache still aligns? that was the original failure.
jessie: ran it — kv-cache desync gone in the remapped build. small remaining hallucination uptick in a few cases but within expected noise.
mike: follow-up: add an assert during export that tokenizer.vocab_size == model.config.vocab_size and that special token ids line up. if mismatch, write out a deterministic conversion table and run the remap step in the onboarding pipeline.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: integration tests finished for branch kamino/onboard-remap — 42/42 passed, 2 flaky tests skipped :rocket:
jessie: thanks all. I'll add a short checklist to the model onboarding runbook: verify special token ids, run per-channel quant, and apply embedding remap when needed. filing a tiny PR with the remap util and the test case. :+1:
cheng: dropping a note — create a tiny unit that loads mixed tokenizer versions and ensures normalization flags are applied consistently. saved us before.
mike: and log the pre/post-quant embedding row checksums in CI so we catch silent reorderings early.
jessie: will do. closing the thread after I land the PR. :wave:
